paragraphs.text: In this paper, we build a comprehensive model to simulate the evolution of AGH population in Wash- ington State. Even though the number won’t change signiﬁcantly, our model indicates that AGH are actively ﬁnding suitable locations to stay and grow. Once they have found some suitable locations, they will reside and grow exponentially, which will only reach a limit when the local honeybees are eaten out so that the environment is no longer suitable for the AGH. Based on multiple simulations of our model, we estimate the "ﬁnding" process will take up about 8 years. After that, the population will start to grow exponentially, reaching 10,000 in the 10th year.
